description:
Delete a webhook endpoint

Unsubscribes the endpoint: no further events are delivered to it, including retries still pending. This is the "unsubscribe" half of a REST-hook trigger; call it when the automation is turned off. Endpoints are scoped to the credential's environment (live/sandbox), so a sandbox key cannot delete a live endpoint.
name: deleteWebhookEndpoint
title: Delete a webhook endpoint
